posts.cooked: mam could you please share normal starting to end procedure for oppe vm it’s structure just like start ssh _____-@sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in then ls /opt/se2001 then seeing questions creating dir for each then synchor show then saving solving then synchro eval is t the steps we will follow in oppe vm?

posts.name: Aastha Kaushik
posts.cooked:
will the code be in this form like we solved GRPA’s? not how we did in command prompt for BPT’s fromat #!/usr/bin/bash with script{} will start, This was format in pyq’s people shared ?

image676×282 50 KB

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Step 1: ssh _____-@sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in
Step 2: cd se2001
Step 3: ls /opt/se2001 or you can see the question name from exam portal
Step 4: Ensure you are in ~/se2001 then create the question directories
Step 5: cd to the one who want to solve
Step 6: Inside question dir,

  • synchro show to see the question,
  • synchro init if asked in the question.
  • synchro eval for submitting
  • synchro status for checking how many you did

Also, chmod +x ______ to the script name must be done

Don’t forget to submit coc & instructions in exam portal on chrome.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Format would be like BPTs not GrPAs
